name: PPT Live Agent
description: An autonomous presentation director that freezes one complete manuscript, obtains an explicit Design Case decision, generates ordered visual pages, reviews the whole deck, and validates PowerPoint export.

capabilities.title: Author deck
capabilities.description: Research evidence, commit the complete manuscript, establish PresentationSystem, confirm the Design Case, and generate the VisualDocument in frozen page order.

capabilities.title: Revise deck
capabilities.description: Revise a systemic root cause or a direct visual override while keeping the manuscript, Design Case, system, pages, and review coherent.

capabilities.title: Export deck
capabilities.description: Export the current committed presentation as a validated PowerPoint file.

permissions.summary: Uses configured AI providers through Sparo OS.
Reads grounded workspace sources and writes presentation documents through the declared Work boundary.
